blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has called for the continuation of the government’s nutrition interventions beyond the completion of a four-year World Bank-supported project, warning that malnutrition remains a serious concern in the country. Marcos on Wednesday said the services introduced under the Philippine Multisectoral Nutrition Project (PMNP) should become part of the regular programs of national and local governments, rather than end with the project’s implementation period this year. “We have to find a way so that this program has no ending.
